##### Project general facts

Al Raha Lofts 1 is a beautifully designed waterfront residential development that brings together modern living and effortless comfort. It offers a wonderfully diverse collection of homes, from ultra-modern studios and stylish New York-style lofts to spacious one, two, three and four bedroom apartments, along with pioneering two-level duplexes. Every apartment comes with its own private terrace or balcony, giving residents a serene space to relax and enjoy their surroundings.

Life here is enriched by a fantastic array of amenities designed for both leisure and wellbeing. Residents can cool off in the swimming pool or the dedicated children's pool, keep active in the fully equipped gymnasium, or enjoy the tennis and football courts. Beautifully landscaped gardens, a children's playground, barbecue areas, convenient retail areas and generous covered parking come together to create a truly welcoming and family-friendly community.

Each residence at Al Raha Lofts 1 is delivered with a full furniture package, making it wonderfully easy to move straight in and feel at home. Interiors feature fully fitted kitchens with cabinets, countertops and appliances including a refrigerator, washing machine and cooker, alongside fully tiled bathrooms, elegant vanity units and mirrors, and quality ceramic floor tiling throughout. Thoughtful finishing touches such as double-glazed windows, central air conditioning, built-in wardrobes and high-speed fibre-optic connectivity ensure every home is as comfortable as it is refined.

##### Location description and benefits

Al Raha Beach stands as a luxurious and captivating waterfront destination nestled along the pristine shores of Abu Dhabi. This master-planned community redefines modern living by seamlessly blending residential, commercial, and recreational elements in a harmonious coastal setting. With its stunning architecture, top-notch amenities, and panoramic views, Al Raha Beach offers a lifestyle of opulence and tranquility that reflects the pinnacle of Abu Dhabi's cosmopolitan charm.

Al Raha Beach is not merely a place to live - it's a destination for unparalleled leisure and recreation. The community boasts a wealth of world-class facilities, including pristine beaches that invite residents to unwind by the water's edge, exclusive gyms and sports centers that cater to fitness enthusiasts, and lush parks and landscaped areas that create serene spots for relaxation and socializing.

The vibrant social fabric of Al Raha Beach is enhanced by its commercial and retail offerings. Shopping centers, dining establishments, and entertainment venues are woven into the community's tapestry, ensuring that residents have easy access to modern conveniences and a diverse array of experiences. Additionally, the community's strategic location offers excellent connectivity to key areas of Abu Dhabi, making it a desirable hub for both business and leisure.
